title: Use one explicit gate runner for local development and CI

tasks.title: Test failure semantics
tasks.acceptance: Distinct failed/blocked semantics; subprocess failures cannot hide as missing tools; timeouts fail; designated prerequisites alone may use exit 69.

tasks.title: Configure Ruff comprehensively
tasks.command: python -m ruff check src scripts quality tests && python -m ruff format --check src scripts quality tests
tasks.acceptance: ALL + preview, formatter/docstring formatting, safe fixes only, two formatter-conflict exemptions and test-local assertions/literals. Real diagnostics not available.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Configure two type checkers
tasks.acceptance: ty all-errors and basedpyright all-rules; no broad ignores or generated baseline. First real run may require annotation/refactor repairs.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Add generative and mutation checks
tasks.acceptance: Eight generative properties and five mutation operators configured; independent JSON score gate rejects zero mutants, inconsistent counts, errors, timeouts and pardons. No mutation score claimed.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Add profiling and security/prose checks
tasks.acceptance: Fixed existing PSA CPU/memory workload; pinned native binary hashes and versions; history/tree secret scans; local prose rules; audit/SBOM. Integrity failures tested, tool executions blocked.
tasks.blocker: External DNS/tool installation or hosted execution is unavailable

tasks.title: Run a fail-closed unified harness
tasks.acceptance: One local/CI entrypoint; quick is never full; all gates attempted; missing prerequisites return nonzero rather than a fabricated release pass.

tasks.title: Verify receipts
tasks.acceptance: Commands, exits, durations, source/input hashes and log digests bound; stale, duplicate, extra-failed or tampered receipts rejected. These are audit records, not cryptographic attestations.

tasks.title: Commit harness evidence
tasks.acceptance: Actual local gate receipts and blockers committed. Author self-review is distinguished from independent and hosted assurance.
